description: LocalFilesystem.list/3 filters current .bedrock-tmp scratch files but exposes legacy .bedrock-lock metadata as object keys. Snapshot.read_latest/1 asks for list(prefix, limit: 1), receives the lexically-first .bedrock-lock key, and fails Keys.extract_version/1 with :invalid_format even though the versioned snapshot beside it is valid. Keep snapshot key parsing strict. At the backend boundary, filter all LocalFilesystem-owned internal filenames, including legacy .bedrock-lock. Add a regression with .bedrock-lock beside a valid versioned snapshot proving limit: 1 returns the snapshot and read_latest succeeds.
title: LocalFilesystem listing exposes legacy internal lock files
